v1.0.0.description:
Every release attaches the same files. `gh release create --generate-notes`
appends the commit list below this.

## Run the stack without a clone

Download `compose.yaml` and `.env.example` into an empty directory:

```sh
mkdir mann-vs-archipelago && cd mann-vs-archipelago
base=https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/releases/latest/download
curl -fsSLO "$base/compose.yaml"
curl -fsSL -o .env "$base/.env.example"
```

Set `SRCDS_RCONPW` in `.env`, then make a session and start:

```sh
docker compose --profile seed run --rm seed   # writes ./seed
docker compose up -d
```

Upload the file from `seed/` at [archipelago.gg/uploads](https://archipelago.gg/uploads),
create a room, and write its port into `AP_PORT`.

The images come from `ghcr.io/m-this/tf2-archipelago`. `compose.yaml` pins them
to this release; set `TF2AP_VERSION` in `.env` to run another one.

To host the session on this machine instead of on archipelago.gg, set
`COMPOSE_PROFILES=selfhost`, `AP_HOST=archipelago`, `AP_PORT=38281` and
`AP_TLS=false`. Then `docker compose up -d` needs no seed and no room.

## The other files

| File | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `tf2_mvm.apworld` | The Archipelago world. Drop it in `custom_worlds/` of an Archipelago 0.6.7 install to generate a seed without Docker. |
| `tf2_archipelago.smx` | The compiled SourceMod plugin, for an existing srcds that the compose file does not run. |
| `meta.json`, `items.json`, `missions.json` | The item and location tables `gamedata/` exports. They are already inside the apworld; they are here to read. |

[The book](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/) covers the rest.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/commits/v1.0.0

v1.3.0.description: Release notes — v1.3.0 Bots play their loadout • Each class gets its own first weapon slot, so Medic starts with the Medigun, Engineer with the Wrench and PDAs, and Spy with the Knife. A run drawing only those three used to be unplayable. • Bots hold their distance by what they carry: a Brass Beast closes in, a Tomislav holds a lane, a shotgun walks in instead of firing from minigun range. • Bots pull a weapon that still has ammo instead of walking at a robot holding an empty one. • Bots buy damage first, and buy it for the weapon in hand. They used to buy at random — hence Heavies with jump height and a stock minigun. • You can name the bot team, in order, and the first seats fill first. New checks • The first tank destroyed in a mission is a check (26 missions have one; Mannhattan’s three run on gates). • The first giant killed in a mission is a check (all 29). • The location table goes from 210 to 265. Run shape • Choose the start mission and the start class, or leave both random. • MVM_EXCLUDED_MISSIONS now actually works on Docker — it reached the container but was never written into the YAML. Fixes • Join button works: it names Team Fortress 2 itself instead of asking the server, and connects to this machine’s network address rather than 127.0.0.1. • Saving settings restarts a running server instead of telling you to. • The launcher restarts the server itself when SourceMod updates its gamedata. • The header follows the run’s current mission instead of showing the configured start mission forever. • Test Mode respects the difficulty tier and the start mission. • A Cash Bundle pays between waves, where it survives; one arriving on an empty server waits instead of vanishing. • Players stay on RED: idle handling no longer gives your seat away, and the bot count no longer grows past six. • DeathLink docs corrected — a team wipe does not fail a wave; the bomb reaching the hatch does. ## Windows Download **`tf2ap.exe`** above. Run it. It installs everything else. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-windows.html) ## Linux / Docker Download **`compose.yaml`** and **`.env.example`**: ```sh mkdir mann-vs-archipelago && cd mann-vs-archipelago base=https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/releases/latest/download curl -fsSLO "$base/compose.yaml" curl -fsSL -o .env "$base/.env.example" ``` Set `SRCDS_RCONPW` in `.env`, then: ```sh docker compose --profile seed run --rm seed # writes ./seed docker compose up -d ``` Upload the file from `seed/` at [archipelago.gg/uploads](https://archipelago.gg/uploads) and put the room's port into `AP_PORT`. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install.html) ## Other assets | File | For | | --- | --- | | `tf2_mvm.apworld` | The official Archipelago app. | | `tf2_archipelago.smx` | A SourceMod server the launcher and compose file don't manage. | | `tf2-defender-bots.zip` | The bots for that same server. Unzip into `tf/`. | | `meta.json`, `items.json`, `missions.json` | The item and check tables, for reference. | **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/commits/v1.3.0
